candidate_ideas.statement: Give a coordinate-free proof of the exact hyperelliptic splitting F≅O(2)⊕O(7).
Determine the residual class and geometry of the locus where two distinct source objects have the same image.
Formulate and prove singleton-fibre recovery at the level of geometric objects or isomorphism classes.
Extend the scheme-scoped hypothesis (H3) to a stack base by proving the required descent statement.
Replace connected-étale-locus language with a proof using the two sections of C×_{P¹}C→C and their behaviour at an étale point.

established_facts.evidence: The quoted lemma gives the degree formula deg(W_{f_i}|_C)=4g+12-4f_i.
established_facts.statement: For the Casnati–Ekedahl bundle W_f on a genus-g degree-four cover, deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f.
With g=6 and f=5, deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1})=6.

established_facts.evidence: The quoted source lemma states this isomorphism and fixes the negative-five twist convention.
established_facts.statement: The relevant failure condition is O_C(Γ)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}, with W_5 defined using the twist γ*O_{P¹}(-5).

established_facts.evidence: The image consists of polynomials in x of degree at most six, while the kernel is H⁰(O(1))·(w²-zv²).
established_facts.statement: In the hyperelliptic model y²=f_14(x), z=x², the restriction H⁰(Sym²E(-6))→H⁰(6A) has seven-dimensional image and two-dimensional kernel.

established_facts.evidence: The explicitly computed restriction map has image dimension 7 and kernel dimension exactly 2, determining the two summands.
established_facts.statement: The hyperelliptic model computation yields the exact splitting F≅O(2)⊕O(7).

established_facts.evidence: Summing h⁰ of the displayed summands gives 0+0+2+2+3=7.
established_facts.statement: For the plane-quintic calculation, Sym²E(-6)≅O(-2)⊕O(-1)⊕O(0)²⊕O(1)⊕O(2) and has seven global sections.

established_facts.evidence: The two vector-space dimensions are explicitly computed as 7 and 6.
established_facts.statement: In the plane-quintic calculation, h⁰(2H+2p)=7, while the subspace of sections vanishing to order at least two at p is H⁰(2H) and has dimension 6.

established_facts.evidence: The two sections agree locally at the étale point and therefore agree on connected reduced C.
established_facts.statement: For a double cover, the identity and deck involution agree globally if they agree at one point where both corresponding sections of pr₁:C×_{P¹}C→C are étale.

established_facts.evidence: This follows from the fibre-dimension formula for the stated two-dimensional fibres.
established_facts.statement: If an incidence space has two-dimensional fibres over a component of B, its corresponding component has dimension dim(B_component)+2.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Distinct parameter points can represent isomorphic objects or repeated members and therefore can have the same image; object-level uniqueness does not imply space-level injectivity.
invalid_steps.statement: Interpreting singleton geometric fibres as singleton fibres of parameter spaces is invalid.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A point can be unramified for the covering map without lying over the globally unbranched base locus, so rigidity of deck transformations on that connected étale locus does not apply.
invalid_steps.statement: Inferring that every unramified point belongs to a connected étale locus over the unbranched base is invalid.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The fibre-dimension formula increases each corresponding component dimension by two.
invalid_steps.statement: Saying that an incidence space with two-dimensional fibres has the same component dimensions as its base is invalid.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Euler characteristic is an alternating sum of cohomology dimensions and does not control reducedness or guarantee the asserted fibrewise support.
invalid_steps.statement: Inferring fibrewise nonemptiness or reduced support solely from χ(L)=1 is invalid.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The relevant weights are 2d and 2d-16, which are unequal.
invalid_steps.statement: Identifying a top-weight cohomological corner with a lowest-weight corner shifted by sixteen is invalid.

reusable_computations.statement: The symbolic degree computation gives deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1})=6.
The symbolic degree computation gives deg(M)=4.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Irreducibility of the balanced base B remains to be proved.
Full S₆ monodromy, including the occurrence of the required loci and a transposition, remains to be proved.
The forgetful morphism still requires proofs of the needed monomorphism, quasi-finiteness, closedness, codimension, local-complete-intersection, and Gysin properties.
The argument is restricted to characteristic zero; positive characteristic remains untreated.
The relative-canonical normalization hypothesis (N) remains an external assumption.
The residual hypothesis (R) remains an external assumption.
Descent of the scheme-scoped hypothesis (H3) to a stack base remains unstated.
The extension effect of the weight-two quotient connecting map on Gr^W_26 H^25 of the weight-one part remains unresolved.
The residual depth-one calculation coupled to the pair (5,8) remains unresolved.
Tate support and Tate assembly are still required to deduce that W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6}) is a direct sum of Q(8).
